h: Marketers reportedly announce new diesel prices after Dangote halts gantry sales
p: Fuel marketers have reportedly released new pump prices after the Dangote Refinery stopped selling diesel at its gantry. It is not yet clear how long the pause will last or how much it will affect supply.
more: Marketers say they are adjusting to the change in supply arrangements.
The reported rise in output at the Edo refinery may ease pressure on diesel.
